description: Source code for the ZioEntry class, representing an entry in a ZIP archive with methods for reading, writing, and manipulating ZIP file entries.

classes.name: ZioEntry
classes.description: Represents a ZIP archive entry with capabilities to read, write, clone, and manage ZIP file data and headers.

methods.name: getLogger
methods.description: Returns the singleton logger instance for this class.

methods.name: readLocalHeader
methods.description: Reads the local file header from the ZIP input stream to initialize entry attributes.

methods.name: writeLocalEntry
methods.description: Writes the local file header and data to the ZIP output stream.

methods.name: getData
methods.description: Returns the data bytes of the ZIP entry.

methods.name: getInputStream
methods.description: Provides an InputStream to read the entry's data, handling decompression if necessary.

methods.name: getOutputStream
methods.description: Provides an OutputStream to write data for this ZIP entry.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Writes the ZIP entry's headers and data to the ZIP output stream.

methods.name: getTime
methods.description: Returns the timestamp of the ZIP entry in Java format.

methods.name: setTime
methods.description: Sets the timestamp of the ZIP entry based on a Java time value.

methods.name: isDirectory
methods.description: Checks if the ZIP entry is a directory.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the ZIP entry.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the name of the ZIP entry.

methods.name: setCompression
methods.description: Sets the compression method for the ZIP entry (0 for stored, 8 for deflate).
